trail.name: Lake Creek - Woodland Trail Loop
trail.coordinateNote: Official NPS Laurance S. Rockefeller Preserve Trailhead marker, approximately 5.3 m from the reviewed USGS access trail. Used for an area forecast, not navigation or a promise of conditions everywhere on the loop.

comparison.note: USGS geometry is about 2.960 miles from the official NPS Preserve trailhead marker, including the shared access leg in both directions. NPS lists 3.0 miles.

photo.alt: A log bench overlooks Phelps Lake and snow-streaked mountains framed by pine trees.
photo.permissionNote: The official activity page credits C. Adams for NPS and displays no third-party restriction. Retain credit and source; no endorsement implied. The same verified south-shore scene serves both Preserve routes without duplicating the large asset.
